postings.title: Accounting & Operations Staff
postings.text:
About Formlabs:

Do you want to change how the world creates?

At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before.

We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us.

Your Impact:

Formlabs is looking for a Finance & Operations Staff to bridge our transactional finance operations and physical plant production. This role is designed for a systems-minded, highly organized professional who thrives at the intersection of accounting, data analysis, and manufacturing operations.

In this role you will spend your time maintaining foundational transactional accuracy and driving inventory control, Bill of Materials maintenance (“BOM”), and workflow optimization.

What You’ll Do:

1. Accounts Payable & Employee Expenses

• High-Speed Transactional Processing: Accurately process vendor invoices, credit notes, and employee Travel & Expense (T&E) reimbursement claims.

• Dispute & Inquiry Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for vendor inquiries, reconciling outstanding balances and resolving processing blocks.

2. Inventory Production Data Entry & Integrity

• Daily Performance Logging: Partner with the plant production team to gather and input daily manufacturing data including the material consumptions, general inventory adjustments into the ERP systems.

• Production Sheet Integrity: Audit daily logs for discrepancies, missing records, or timing lags to ensure the team is working with 100% accurate plant-floor data.

3. Inventory Management, Costing & BOM Maintenance

• BOM & Cost Maintenance: Support the maintenance of accurate Bills of Materials (BOMs) and item costs in the ERP, flagging structural discrepancies between planned and actual configurations.

• Physical & Systemic Inventory Audits: Coordinate periodically inventory reconciliations, and research inventory counting variances.

4. Process Optimization & Analytical Support

• Continuous Improvement Execution: Actively look for small, daily efficiencies. Partner with leadership to identify manual bottlenecks on both the accounting and plant sides.

• Data Reporting & SOPs: Assist managers by pulling and formatting variance reports to provide leadership with the clean data needed to make strategic decisions.

About You:

• You are energized by both office finance work and factory-floor operations.

• You enjoy working across teams (from accounting managers to production line workers) to close process loops.

• You are highly receptive to feedback, eager to learn, and open-minded.

• You enjoy learning how software applications integrate. You want to understand how data flows between Coupa, NetSuite,etc..

• Demonstrated experience resolving transactional discrepancies in a fast-paced environment.

Qualifications & Experience:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or related field is required

• Experience: 2–4 years of experience in plant manufacturing environment with key focus on accounts payable, inventory management, cost accounting, and data analysis,.

• Systems Exposure: Direct experience using mid-to-enterprise ERP platforms (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Hyperion HFM or QAD) and modern procurement databases (Concur or Coupa) is highly preferred.

• BOM & Inventory Literacy: Solid foundational understanding of inventories, Bill of Materials configurations.

• Excel / Google Sheets Proficiency: Intermediate spreadsheet skills (XLOOKUP, VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables) to easily clean and analyze production databases and support management reporting.

Our Benefits & Perks:

• Medical, Dental, Vision

• 3% match of yearly salary for 401(k)

• EAP Program

• In-office catering 3x per week

• 120 hours of PTO per year

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing.

postings.title: Director, Strategic Finance
postings.text:
About Formlabs:

Do you want to change how the world creates?

At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before.

We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, build it with us.

Your Impact:

Formlabs is scaling rapidly across new products, channels, and global markets, and the decisions in front of us — where to invest, how to price, which verticals to enter — will define our trajectory for years to come. As Director of Strategic Finance, you will be the analytical engine behind our most important strategic bets. You’ll lead the cross-functional projects that shape pricing strategy, market entry, and capital allocation, and partner directly with the CFO and executive team on board-level reporting. This is a high-visibility role for a builder who wants to translate complex business questions into rigorous frameworks that help leadership make better bets — and to do it inside a hardware company where the economics actually matter.

What You’ll Do:

• Own the development and maintenance of Formlabs’ long-range financial plan, integrating assumptions across product lines, geographies, and channels into a unified corporate model.

• Build and deliver board materials and executive-level financial packages, including strategic narratives, scenario analyses, and KPI dashboards that frame Formlabs’ performance and trajectory for the Board and senior leadership.

• Lead cross-functional strategic projects end-to-end — pricing strategy for new product launches, GTM investment cases for new verticals (dental, industrial, education), and geographic expansion analyses.

• Develop financial frameworks and decision tools that enable leadership to evaluate trade-offs: build vs buy, channel mix optimization, and R&D portfolio prioritization.

• Partner with the Head of Finance and CFO to shape the annual operating plan, ensuring top-down strategic targets are grounded in bottom-up operational reality.

• Serve as a strategic thought partner to business unit leaders across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations, bringing financial rigor to their planning processes.

• Monitor competitive dynamics, market sizing, and industry trends across 3D printing and digital fabrication; distill insights into actionable strategic recommendations.

• Drive process improvements in how Formlabs communicates financial performance and strategy to internal and external stakeholders.

About You:

• 8-12 years of progressive experience in strategic finance, corporate strategy, investment banking, or management consulting, with at least 3-4 years in an in-house strategic finance or corporate strategy role at a scaling company.

• Demonstrated track record of building board-level materials and presenting to or supporting C-suite and board audiences.

• Experience leading cross-functional strategic projects from scoping through recommendation — ideally including pricing strategy, market entry analysis, or GTM investment cases.

• Strong financial modeling skills with the ability to build flexible, scenario-driven models from scratch; comfortable with large data sets and proficient in Excel/Sheets, SQL, and BI tools (Looker, Tableau).

• Exceptional strategic thinker who can zoom out to see the big picture and zoom in to pressure-test the details in the same conversation.

• Outstanding communicator who can distill complex analyses into crisp, compelling narratives for board and executive audiences.

• High agency and ownership mentality — thrives on ambiguous problems and drives them to resolution without heavy direction.

• Deeply analytical but commercially minded — understands that the goal is better decisions, not just better models.

Bonus Skills:

• Prior experience at a hardware or “hard tech” company, with a strong understanding of physical product economics (BOM, COGS, manufacturing scale curves, channel margins).

• Investment banking (TMT, industrials) or top-tier strategy consulting background, with a successful transition into an operating role.

• Experience supporting or leading capital allocation decisions at a scaling, product-led company.

• Genuine curiosity about 3D printing, advanced manufacturing, and how new technology creates customer value.

Our Benefits & Perks:

• Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs

• Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)

• 401K matching and access to financial advisors

• Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks)

• Tenure-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks)

• Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it

• Ample on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits

• Healthy on-site lunches, snacks, beverages, & treats

• Regularly sponsored professional development opportunities

• Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community

• And of course… unlimited 3D prints

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply.

Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing.

Compensation

Every Formlabs employee receives equity because everyone contributes to building the company. You’ll have the opportunity to share financially in the value we create together, with a shared incentive to build a business that succeeds over the long term. Equity will be a significant portion of your total compensation, and will increase over time in proportion to your impact. The base pay will be determined by your skills, qualifications, experience, location, and expected impact on the organization.

The annual base pay range for this role is:

$105,000—$200,000 USD

postings.title: FP&A Analyst
postings.text:
About Formlabs:

Do you want to change how the world creates?

At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before.

We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us.

Your Impact:

As an FP&A Analyst, you’ll partner closely with leaders across the business to bring analytical rigor and clear financial insight to our operations. You’ll be a financial business partner to executives, own the financial model behind our inventory & COGS, drive automated reporting using SQL, develop gross margin and pricing recommendations across our printers, consumables, and services, and support corporate Treasury operations to keep our global subsidiaries well-funded. It’s a hands-on role with broad exposure across the company — ideal for someone who wants to deeply understand how products are designed, built, and brought to market.

What You’ll Do:

• Partner directly with executive leaders across the company to monitor performance-to-budget across all programs.

• Build and maintain long-term inventory and COGS forecasts grounded in unit economics and go-to-market assumptions for new products in the pipeline.

• Analyze and forecast gross margin by product line — tracking BOM costs, manufacturing variances, and mix effects — and develop pricing recommendations for both new launches and existing SKUs.

• Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting (Looker, SQL) that give leadership real-time visibility into spend, headcount, and program health.

• Prepare monthly and quarterly financial packages for the CFO and executive team, including commentary on key drivers and risks.

• Support Treasury functions including subsidiary funding, intercompany transactions, cash management, and FX exposure tracking across Formlabs’ global entities.

• Drive continuous improvement of FP&A processes, models, and systems (NetSuite, Looker, planning tools) to scale with the business.

About You:

• 1-4 years of progressive FP&A, corporate finance, or strategic finance experience; prior roles as an FP&A Analyst, Senior Analyst, or Finance Business Partner preferred.

• Demonstrated knowledge or experience in a hardware-oriented company (e.g., 3D printing, robotics, semiconductors, consumer electronics, industrial equipment, medical devices), with a working understanding of physical product economics: BOM, COGS, tooling, and NPI cycles.

• Hands-on experience with gross margin analysis, cost modeling and accounting.

• Strong technical proficiency with ERP systems (NetSuite strongly preferred), SQL, and BI/visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, or similar).

• Strong communicator who can translate complex financial data into clear narratives for non-finance stakeholders.

• High ownership mentality — comfortable operating with ambiguity and proactively identifying problems before being asked.

• Detail-oriented with strong modeling discipline, but able to zoom out and think strategically about the big picture.

• Collaborative and low-ego; thrives in cross-functional settings with engineering and product teams.

Bonus Skills:

• Background in data analytics, investment banking, or Big 4 transaction advisory.

• Intellectual curiosity about how products are designed, built, and brought to market — tinkerers and makers welcome.

• Experience working in a fast-paced, scaling environment where processes are still being built and refined.

Our Benefits & Perks:

• Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs

• Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)

• 401K matching and access to financial advisors

• Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks)

• Tenure-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks)

• Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it

• Ample on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits

• Healthy on-site lunches, snacks, beverages, & treats

• Regular sponsored professional development opportunities

• Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community

• And of course… unlimited 3D prints

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply.

Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing.

Compensation

Every Formlabs employee receives equity because everyone contributes to building the company. You’ll have the opportunity to share financially in the value we create together, with a shared incentive to build a business that succeeds over the long term. Equity will be a significant portion of your total compensation, and will increase over time in proportion to your impact. The base pay will be determined by your skills, qualifications, experience, location, and expected impact on the organization.

$70,000—$130,000 USD

postings.title: Head of FP&A and Strategic Finance
postings.text:
About Formlabs:

Do you want to change how the world creates?

At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before.

We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us.

Your Impact:

We’re looking for a Head of FP&A and Strategic Finance to join our team! You will report to our Chief Financial Officer and the executive leadership team. You will have visibility across the entire company and to its investors.

If you’re excited about financial models while managing and growing your own global team, we want you to join our Formlabs team as our Head of FP&A and Strategic Finance.

What You’ll Do:

• Own the Company’s financial model including developing, implementing and managing all necessary models to support the company operating plan, sales forecasts, strategic initiatives, multi-year business plans, M&A opportunities and sensitivity analyses.

• Manage and build out the FP&A team as the business grows.

• Integrate finance and business. Develop partnerships with business leaders across the organization to engage in financial planning activities that lead decisions and operations.

• Take lead in setting and coordinating annual and multi-year Company board plans.

• Work with department heads to inform, plan, and manage their plans.

• Develop, report, and automate financial reporting and KPI dashboards to provide management with forecast insights, performance metrics and financial analytics for improved organizational decision-making.

• Provide insights to all areas of business using analytics and benchmarking.

• Develop and/or enhance financial and operational systems and tools (ERP, modeling & BI/reporting) to increase efficiency and visibility.

• Work with the CFO, Controller and Business Leads to ensure data integrity and consistency in data across the company (across various sources).

• Partner with accounting, tax and corporate to develop entity level forecasting models and improve timeliness of internal reporting.

• Ad hoc reporting and special projects.

About You:

• Have applicable work experience in roles of increasing responsibility which may include banking, private equity, FP&A, business development, or other relevant environments.

• Have experience with financial forecasting, planning, analysis and operational budget management.

• Are highly analytical with great attention to detail.

• Have excellent communication and presentation skills.

• Are naturally curious and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment.

• Are able to build strong relationships with colleagues and present to business leaders.

• Had management experience with team ownership.

Bonus Skills:

• Additional experience working in technology, management consulting, investment banking, venture capital, and/or private equity.

• Familiarity with Adaptive Planning & NetSuite.

• Experience in Software/Tech/Hardware industries.

• MBA, CPA or CMA, CFA.

• IPO and/or public company experience.

Our Benefits & Perks:

• Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs

• Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)

• 401K matching and access to financial advisors

• Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks)

• Tenure-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks)

• Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it

• Ample on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits

• Healthy on-site lunches, snacks, beverages, & treats

• Regular sponsored professional development opportunities

• Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community
